designated_regression.basis: Permanent rule explicitly forbids oral debt cancellation before delivery; no instance premise is needed.

semantic_review.reviewer: Author self-review, not independent or blind

notes_by_case.hv11-001: 永久规则明确排除口头免债；只需该规则即可反证，不依赖任何一笔债务的实例状态。
notes_by_case.hv11-002: 同一时间的动作、执行者与目的均有直接叙述。
notes_by_case.hv11-003: 形状相似不能唯一确定产地，缺出土记录或材料比对；也没有证据排除该窑址。
notes_by_case.hv11-004: 来源明确为锡且无铜，与草稿材质相反；草稿未限定同刻，按新口径接受可能矛盾，不将缺时间单独标成证据不足。
notes_by_case.hv11-005: 原文明示补片颜色与选定者；草稿未断言修补已经完成。
notes_by_case.hv11-006: 两人均有同款匣，无独有标记、目击或认领，缺失物主身份环节。
notes_by_case.hv11-007: 同一时间明确混音执行者只有沈玦，祁沅未参与；考察谁完成该工作。
notes_by_case.hv11-008: 直接支持材料、动作和执行者。
notes_by_case.hv11-009: 各自可能以一倍或二倍速度播放，实际时长可为40或80秒与50或100秒，顺序无法确定。
notes_by_case.hv11-010: 原文明示该时刻尚不知道且无判断，不能从她持有未拆信封推出获知。
notes_by_case.hv11-012: 来棚试唱和等待区照片不能对应到最终采用的这一句，缺分轨身份信息。
notes_by_case.hv11-013: 同日唯一修订页18点12分送达，唯一封口18点，故送达在封口之后；须联合两章。
notes_by_case.hv11-015: 两个袋号与两个目的地之间缺对应关系，任一排列均未被排除。
notes_by_case.hv11-016: 人物留在三号分拣间，该间位于与西楼互斥的东楼；人物位置与建筑映射共同反证。
notes_by_case.hv11-017: 原文直接支持关窗动作。
notes_by_case.hv11-018: 只知箱宽九十厘米，缺收窄处净宽，无法确定能否通过。
notes_by_case.hv11-019: The cape belongs to the brown-wrapped group; every member is in the blue hamper at the same time, and the yellow trunk is spatially separate. Both passages are necessary.
notes_by_case.hv11-020: The source directly describes this action and its time.
notes_by_case.hv11-021: A combined total does not identify the deposit component; both a full and a partial deposit refund remain compatible with the receipt.
notes_by_case.hv11-022: The same-time material inspection explicitly establishes cotton with no linen; only this physical attribute is disputed.
notes_by_case.hv11-023: The card replacement is directly narrated.
notes_by_case.hv11-024: Only two were measured. Neither the sizes of the other six nor a uniform-size packing specification is available.
notes_by_case.hv11-025: The source explicitly places four barrels in P12. The draft supplies no time scope, so possible_conflict is acceptable under the new non-designated policy; missing time alone is not a missing-evidence case.
notes_by_case.hv11-026: The source directly states the painter, ring and time.
notes_by_case.hv11-027: The booking establishes group size but provides no ages or school affiliation; a school class is possible but unconfirmed.
notes_by_case.hv11-028: The source explicitly says the public demonstration has not started. The undated draft asserts the opposite status; possible_conflict is acceptable, without treating the separate private equipment check as the public event.
notes_by_case.hv11-029: Halfway closure directly supports partial closure without claiming complete darkness.
notes_by_case.hv11-030: Successful unloaded bench operation supplies neither an adequate load rating nor a loaded ramp trial, so the required capability remains unknown.
notes_by_case.hv11-031: The exclusive Rell-to-Odrin identity and the sole-translator credit jointly exclude Feska; neither passage alone establishes the complete attribution.
notes_by_case.hv11-032: The action is explicitly described with that time.
notes_by_case.hv11-033: Both meanings are established, but the context needed to select one is missing; neither sense is ruled out.
notes_by_case.hv11-034: One source establishes Dewline as a required member of the complete collection; the other establishes it remains unpublished at that time, preventing completion of publication of the whole collection.
notes_by_case.hv11-035: The placement action and time are directly supported.
notes_by_case.hv11-036: Dispatch on the 24th does not fix the arrival date; no delivery scan or reply supplies the missing date.

ordinary_conflict_policy: Ordinary conflict cases may be qualified as confirmed_conflict or possible_conflict. Missing shared time alone is not classified as insufficient_evidence. Only the three designated regressions require confirmed_conflict and the correct category.
